Event.description: Significant event in the lifecycle of moving image work / variant, manifestation or item. Always specify the type of event and if possible a date or a period of time via has_date. Specify located_in as appropriate, e.g. the country where the principal offices or production facilities of the production company are located for a production event. Involved parties in various roles can be linked via has_activity. See also: FIAF Moving Image Cataloguing Manual 1.4.2, 2.4.2, 3.3.2

slots.description: Location associated with an event, e.g. the country where the principal offices or production facilities of the production company are located should be associated with the production event

slots.description: Designates type, e.g. to distinguish different identifiers (GNDResource vs. VIAFResource)

slots.name: has_primary_title
slots.description: Primary title to be displayed in search results etc. The type should be PreferredTitle for works / variants and TitleProper for manifestations / items. If not available, type must be SuppliedDevisedTitle, instead.

slots.name: has_alternative_title
slots.description: Additional title(s) associated with the work / variant, manifestation, or item.

slots.name: has_identifier
slots.description: Record PID in this slot when exporting data from the PID system. Use local identifiers instead when PIDs have not been registered yet. The latter is suitable for transferring data to the agent responsible for registering PIDs

slots.name: same_as
slots.description: Another identifier for the same item, e.g. a DOI. Can also be used to link to another AVefi record describing the same item, e.g. when it has changed hands and the new custodian registers its own record for the item

slots.name: has_event
slots.description: Associate event(s) with a moving image record

slots.name: in_language
slots.description: FIAF Moving Image Cataloguing Manual 1.3.5, 2.3.3

slots.name: has_format
slots.description: FIAF Moving Image Cataloguing Manual 2.3.4.1, 3.1.5.1

slots.name: has_duration
slots.description: Total running time of the described object in ISO 8601 duration format. See also: FIAF Moving Image Cataloguing Manual 2.3.5.3, 3.1.5.11

slots.name: has_extent
slots.description: Physical length or size of the described object. See also: FIAF Moving Image Cataloguing Manual 2.3.5.2, 3.1.5.8

slots.name: has_colour_type
slots.description: FIAF Moving Image Cataloguing Manual 2.3.4.4, 3.1.5.6, D.7.11

slots.name: has_sound_type
slots.description: FIAF Moving Image Cataloguing Manual 2.3.4.3, 3.1.5.3, D.7.4

slots.name: has_webresource
slots.description: Link to data provider's own presentation of manifestation or item on the web

slots.name: has_note
slots.description: FIAF Moving Image Cataloguing Manual Appendix B

slots.name: is_item_of
slots.description: Indicate AVefi Manifestation the item belongs to. Every item must be associated with a manifestation from the same data provider

slots.name: element_type
slots.description: FIAF Moving Image Cataloguing Manual D.7.8

slots.name: has_access_status
slots.description: Status of item determining access conditions. See also FIAF Moving Image Cataloguing Manual D.7.1

slots.name: has_frame_rate
slots.description: Frame Rate describes the number of frames per second of an item. See also: FIAF Moving Image Cataloguing Manual 3.1.5.12.

slots.name: is_copy_of
slots.description: Link to AVefi item registered by another institution indicating that the two are known to be copies of each other

slots.name: is_derivative_of
slots.description: Link to AVefi item from which this one has been derived in whole or in part, e.g. as a result of a restoration or digitasation project

slots.name: described_by
slots.description: Also record some metadata about the PID itself rather than the identified object

slots.name: has_record
slots.description: Root slot holding the moving image metadata record, i.e. metadata describing a work/variant, manifestation or item. See also the Introduction of the FIAF Moving Image Cataloguing Manual

slots.name: URL
slots.description: URL specifying the destination where clients should be redirected to when resolving the PID of a moving image record

AuthorityResource.description: Root class for all identifiers from some kind of authority or public register widely accepted in the community

slots.description: Designates type, e.g. to distinguish different identifiers (GNDResource vs. VIAFResource)

slots.name: id
slots.description: A unique identifier for a thing
